subject: Renewal: EU onshore residency add-on + APAC surge pilot coordination
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Chris Jordan <cjordan@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: EU onshore residency add-on + APAC surge pilot coordination

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Per our call, I pulled together a single addendum that covers: (1) EU onshore residency (dedicated tenancy + data at-rest in the Frankfurt node), (2) a 6-month APAC surge pilot (warm-standby capacity with burst credits), and (3) a cross-region failover SLA for critical endpoints.

Attached is Draft_Addendum_v3 with the updated terms and a preliminary SOW for the APAC pilot. The big asks from your side that I captured: EU residency hard requirement for PHI, a 99.9% standby readiness window for APAC during business hours, and a two-week notice window for failover drills.

Two quick questions for alignment:
- On pricing: would you prefer to take the EU onshore as a one-time onboarding fee + monthly residency surcharge, or folded into an annual committed capacity line item?
- For the APAC pilot, do you expect traffic spiking to 2-3x daily peak for short windows, or is it sustained uplift over multiple hours? That will change the recommended burst sizing.

Can you review and let me know by EOD Friday so we can route to procurement? If it's easier we can jump on a quick 30-min call Thursday morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NovaMed_Draft_Addendum_v3.pdf (PDF, 345KB)]

From: Chris Jordan <cjordan@novamed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@novaops.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Renewal: EU onshore residency add-on + APAC surge pilot coordination

Marissa —

Thanks for sending this over. High level: NovaMed is comfortable with the residency add-on as an annualized line item (we prefer predictable monthly invoicing). For the APAC pilot, we expect bursts tied to campaign surges — spikes of 2-3x for 30–90 minutes, a few times per week, and occasional multi-hour periods during region-wide campaigns.

Procurement flagged two items they need before signing: a) explicit data retention policy for EU-stored logs, and b) a runbook for the cross-region failover test (we need to validate no data duplication during failover). Lina will send the security checklist.

We'll aim to get feedback by Friday end of day. If you can provide the runbook skeleton and retention clause, that would speed sign-off.

—Chris
Chris Jordan
Head of Platform Operations, NovaMed Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Chris Jordan <cjordan@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: EU onshore residency add-on + APAC surge pilot coordination

Thanks Chris — looping in Ops and Solutions to close the two items.

Ben / Karthik / Hannah — can one of you confirm the following and we'll drop into the addendum:
1) Retention settings: we can offer 90 / 365 / custom (customer-managed KMS to enforce encryption-at-rest). For NovaMed's PHI use, recommend 365 with soft-delete disabled for EU tenancy.
2) Failover runbook: provide a summary runbook that covers failover trigger conditions, KV-cache reconciliation approach, expected RTO (target 5–10 mins), and a post-failover audit. Chris requested confirmation there will be no duplicate deliveries during KV resyncs.

Also: pricing recommendation — we propose folding EU onshore as a monthly residency surcharge of $1,500/month plus a one-time onboarding fee of $12,000 for tenant provisioning & compliance attestation. APAC pilot: 1.5x burst credits on top of committed baseline, included for 6 months; overage billing thereafter.

Attaching the SOW for APAC pilot with estimated burst profile.

[Attachment: SOW_APAC_Pilot.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

If you confirm the retention and runbook approach I can update the addendum and send to Procurement for countersign.

-Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: EU onshore residency add-on + APAC surge pilot coordination

On Fri, Jul 13, 2028 at 08:22 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Chris — looping in Ops and Solutions to close the two items.
>
> Ben / Karthik / Hannah — can one of you confirm the following and we'll drop into the addendum:
> 1) Retention settings: we can offer 90 / 365 / custom (customer-managed KMS to enforce encryption-at-rest). For NovaMed's PHI use, recommend 365 with soft-delete disabled for EU tenancy.
> 2) Failover runbook: provide a summary runbook that covers failover trigger conditions, KV-cache reconciliation approach, expected RTO (target 5–10 mins), and a post-failover audit. Chris requested confirmation there will be no duplicate deliveries during KV resyncs.

Marissa / Team — confirmed.
- Retention: we'll go with 365 days, soft-delete off, customer-managed KMS. Ops will include a retention appendix and a signed KMS integration checklist.
- Failover runbook: we'll provide a short-form runbook (2–3 pages) addressing trigger conditions, pre-failover snapshot process, KV-resync steps and idempotency safeguards. Expected RTO 7 minutes in our tests; we'll include audit steps to prove no duplication.

I'll incorporate those into the addendum and have Marissa circulate the updated PDF by EOD. Recommend we include a DocuSign link and a 30-day onboarding window post-signature.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Internal note: hand off to Professional Services for provisioning estimates after countersign.]
